name: CoorT
formula: =LAMBDA(h,b,tf,tw,[isRepeatFirstPoint],LET(isRepeat, IF(ISOMITTED(isRepeatFirstPoint), FALSE, TRUE), xa, b / 2, ya, 0, xb, b / 2, yb, -tf, xc, tw / 2, yc, -tf, xd, tw / 2, yd, -h, rowA, HSTACK(xa, ya), rowB, HSTACK(xb, yb), rowC, HSTACK(xc, yc), rowD, HSTACK(xd, yd), rowE, HSTACK(-xd, yd), rowF, HSTACK(-xc, yc), rowG, HSTACK(-xb, yb), rowH, HSTACK(-xa, ya), output, IF(isRepeat, VSTACK(rowH, rowG, rowF, rowE, rowD, rowC, rowB, rowA, rowH), VSTACK(rowH, rowG, rowF, rowE, rowD, rowC, rowB, rowA)), output))
comment: Create coordinates of vertices for a T Section. isRepeatFirstPoint = FALSE by default. Last Update at 2024-07-02.
